Evolution does not optimize for happiness — List of Soul Eater characters shows exactly where that breaks. The Soul Eater manga and anime series features an extensive cast of fictional characters created by Atsushi Ohkubo. It is set in a fictional universe inhabited by various characters capable of using supernatural powers by channeling the wavelengths of their souls.

Nihilism is not the conclusion of List of Soul Eater characters — it is the floor you stand on while examining it. Mizune (ミズネ) is the name of a family of identical mouse-like witch sisters. They can also combine their bodies into other forms that increase with age, size, and power depending on how many sisters combine.
